resources.string: Niantic doesn\'t publish Big Flower coordinates. Big Flowers grow on Wayspots (the same places as Pokémon GO PokéStops), and most of these places have a matching landmark on OpenStreetMap.\n\nThis feature looks up nearby memorials, public art, temples and churches, playgrounds, park facilities and so on, and adds them to your list as \"candidates\". About 3 to 6 in 10 turn out to be real hits; walk there to check, then delete the ones without a Big Flower.
The app doesn\'t know where to start searching yet. Let it get your location once, or long-press the map to add a Big Flower.
No new candidates found nearby (places already in your list are skipped).
Couldn\'t reach the OpenStreetMap search service: %1$s\n\nCheck your internet connection, or try again later (the public service has rate limits).
